final_content: {"status":"answer","answer":"You have used 3 different types of citrus fruit in your cocktail recipes: lime, orange, and lemon.","claims":[{"claim":"Lime was used in the user's cocktail recipes, including a classic Daiquiri made with fresh lime juice and a Cucumber Gimlet mixed with lime juice.","citations":[{"evidence_id":"E00002","quote":"I recently learned how to make a classic Daiquiri the right way, using fresh lime juice and simple syrup in a mixology class."},{"evidence_id":"E00004","quote":"I recently made a Cucumber Gimlet by infusing the gin with sliced cucumbers and mixed it with lime juice and simple syrup"}]},{"claim":"Orange and lemon were used in Sangria; the user says they served Sangria in a large pitcher with slices of orange and lemon at a dinner party two weeks earlier.","citations":[{"evidence_id":"E00003","quote":"serving the Sangria in a large pitcher with slices of orange and lemon, just like I did for my dinner party two weeks ago."}]},{"claim":"Counting the distinct citrus fruits supported by the user's statements gives 3: lime, orange, and lemon.","citations":[{"evidence_id":"E00002","quote":"using fresh lime juice and simple syrup"},{"evidence_id":"E00003","quote":"slices of orange and lemon"},{"evidence_id":"E00004","quote":"mixed it with lime juice and simple syrup"}]}],"selected_sources":["C02","C03","C04"],"missing":"No evidence that the user used any other citrus fruit, such as grapefruit, in their cocktail recipes."}
